name: A01_8_another_watcher_buffs_the_first_but_never_itself
notes: Printed: 'Whenever ANOTHER creature you control with flying enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.' A second Watcher of the Spheres (a flier) is cast from the hand ({W}{U} from the pool; there is no generic part for the first Watcher to reduce): the first Watcher gets +1/+1 (3/3), the second, which entered itself, does not (2/2).
